title: The Didache
blurb: A short church manual on ethics, baptism, fasting, and the Eucharist.

refScheme.note: Chapter and verse, as printed in standard editions of the Greek text (e.g. Lake 1912). Cited as didache.<chapter>.<verse>.

editorial.note: 16 chapters and the chapter 1 verse divisions (1–6) agree in Lake (1912) and the Greek Wikisource text. Chapters 2–16 not yet checked. Awaiting editorial sign-off against a modern critical edition (e.g. Holmes).

reviews.method: Compared chapter 1 verse boundaries in two named witnesses (docs/REFERENCES.md).
